high_level_description: This image captures a stunning sunset over the ocean. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds that are illuminated by the warm hues of the setting sun. The colors range from deep oranges and reds near the horizon to darker shades of gray and black higher up in the sky, creating a striking contrast. The sun itself is partially obscured by the clouds, casting a bright, golden light that reflects off the water below. The ocean appears calm with gentle waves, and the light from the sunset creates a shimmering effect on the surface of the water.
